name: Dumbbell Biceps Curl
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, arms by your sides and palms facing forward.
Keeping your upper arms close to your body, bend your elbows to bring the weights up toward your shoulders.
Pause briefly at the top without letting your shoulders shrug up.
Lower the weights slowly until your arms are straight again.
technique_considerations: Choose a weight you can lift without swinging your body.
Keep your elbows near your sides rather than drifting forward.
Breathe out as you lift and in as you lower.
